name: Assigned Application
description: A user or a group is assigned an application: the assignment is what puts the app on a user's dashboard and lets Okta issue an assertion for them. A user's assignment may itself come from a group (scope GROUP).

scope.description: For a user assignment: USER when assigned directly, GROUP when inherited from a group assignment.

priority.description: For a group assignment: its priority when several groups assign the same app with different profiles.
